item-handbooktext-grapplinghook:
WARNING: USE AT YOUR OWN RISK. HIGH RISK OF INJURY.

Fire a hook that latches onto whatever it hits and pulls you toward it. Hook a creature and the tables turn: smaller targets come to you, but if your catch is too big, you're going to it. Hit something rideable and enjoy the express trip straight into the nearest available seat!

CONTROLS

Grapple controls can be configured under Options - Controls.
toolmode-swing-desc: A short automatic boost followed by momentum-based swinging. Use the configurable grapple controls to adjust the rope.
toolmode-straight-desc: Continuously reel straight toward the grapple point.
inputmode-hold-desc: Hold Shoot Grapple to stay attached. Release it to detach.
inputmode-click-desc: Press Shoot Grapple once to fire and remain locked. Use Lock / Detach Grapple to detach.
